description: This file defines the class TemplateFloat which extends TemplateRange. It specifies properties and methods related to handling a float data type for a dynamic field in the SuiteCRM platform, including field definition and database type determination.

classes.name: TemplateFloat
classes.description: Represents a float type field for dynamic fields with properties like length and precision, and methods to define the field and determine its database column type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateFloat object, calls parent constructor, and sets up vardef mapping for precision.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the extended field definition array, adding precision information.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Determines the database column type string based on length and precision, using DBManagerFactory.
